segments.description: Originates, acquires and manages commercial real estate debt investments across the capital stack.
segments.evidence: Senior and Mezzanine Loans and Preferred Equity—CRE debt investments including senior and mezzanine loans, and preferred equity interests as well as participations in such loans.

segments.name: Net Leased and Other Real Estate
segments.description: Direct investments in commercial real estate with long-term net leases to tenants responsible for operating expenses.
segments.evidence: Net Leased and Other Real Estate—direct investments in commercial real estate with long-term leases to tenants on a net lease basis, where such tenants generally will be responsible for property operating expenses such as insurance, utilities, maintenance, capital expenditures and real estate taxes.

revenueModel.text: Investors pay the company for commercial real estate debt investments generating interest income and for net leased real estate generating rental income.
revenueModel.evidence: We are an internally-managed commercial real estate ("CRE") credit real estate investment trust ("REIT") focused on originating, acquiring, financing and managing a diversified portfolio consisting primarily of CRE debt investments and net leased properties.
